roadmap.title: Learn the campaigns and build natural progress
roadmap.description: Complete the five launch campaigns on Easy or Normal, learn the finales, and collect straightforward combat, uncommon-infected, rescue, and cumulative achievements without farming. Check the in-game Achievements page after each session.

roadmap.title: Campaign-specific challenges and grinds
roadmap.description: Revisit Dead Center, Dark Carnival, Swamp Fever, Hard Rain, and The Parish for their set-piece challenges. Finish the melee, weapon, and lifetime counters only after natural campaign progress.

roadmap.title: Expert, Realism, and DLC campaigns
roadmap.description: Clear the five launch campaigns on Expert, overlap one run with Expert Realism, then complete The Passing, The Sacrifice, and Cold Stream while handling their unique objectives.

roadmap.title: Organized Versus and Scavenge
roadmap.description: Assemble human partners for role-specific infected actions, the full Dead Air match, Team Versus or Team Scavenge, and cumulative gas-can tasks. Use private lobbies so both teams can coordinate exact setups.

roadmap.title: Survival and The Last Stand
roadmap.description: Clear The Last Stand, collect its hidden-room achievement, then work through every official Survival arena toward gold medals, the 30-minute hold, and the melee-only medal.

roadmap.title: Calendar and viral cleanup
roadmap.description: Collect Valve gifts during December, find a qualifying 2013 holiday-giveaway owner, and monitor Valve announcements for the next free weekend required by Good Guy Nick.

achievements.description: Honk the noses of 10 Clowns.
achievements.summary: Honk 10 @enemy{Clown} noses by shoving the Clowns rather than killing them.

guide.context: One Clown can supply several honks because each melee shove counts separately; an ordinary Clown usually survives up to four shoves.

steps.text: Start @loc{Dark Carnival} and watch for @enemy{Clowns} among the Common Infected.
Use the melee-shove input on each @enemy{Clown}'s face, then stop attacking and find another Clown when it dies; accumulate 10 nose honks.

achievements.description: Using a Molotov, burn a Clown leading at least 10 Common Infected.
achievements.summary: Wait until a @enemy{Clown} has drawn at least 10 @enemy{Common Infected} behind it, then ignite that group with a @item{Molotov}.

guide.context: @loc{Dark Carnival} is the only launch campaign with Clowns. Wait for a horde that is following a Clown's squeaking footsteps before throwing the Molotov.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{Dark Carnival}, wait until a @enemy{Clown} has drawn at least 10 @enemy{Common Infected} behind it, then ignite that group with a @item{Molotov}.

achievements.description: Kill a Charger with a melee weapon while they are charging.
achievements.summary: Land the killing melee blow on a @enemy{Charger} during its forward charge.

guide.context: A @enemy{Charger} normally survives one melee hit, so weaken it below roughly 300 health before baiting a straight charge past the melee player.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{Swamp Fever}, land the killing melee blow on a @enemy{Charger} during its forward charge.

achievements.description: Kill a Spitter before she is able to spit.
achievements.summary: Eliminate a @enemy{Spitter} before it launches its first acid projectile.

guide.context: @enemy{Spitters} usually attack as soon as they gain sight of survivors. Listen for the spawn cue, aim at the bright green silhouette, and fire before the acid projectile leaves its mouth.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{Dead Center}, eliminate a @enemy{Spitter} before it launches its first acid projectile.

achievements.description: Finish a campaign using only melee weapons.
achievements.summary: Complete an entire campaign without firing a gun; use melee weapons and permitted throwables from the opening chapter through the rescue.

guide.context: Firing the pistol while incapacitated invalidates the attempt. The restriction applies to the player pursuing the achievement, so teammates may still use firearms.

steps.text: Start a short campaign on Easy and immediately take a melee weapon without firing the starting pistol.
Use only melee attacks and throwables through every chapter; if incapacitated, do not fire the pistol.
Board the rescue vehicle while still meeting the restriction and remain through the credits.

achievements.description: Kill one of each Uncommon Infected.
achievements.summary: Personally kill a @enemy{CEDA Worker}, @enemy{Worker Infected}, @enemy{Mudman}, and @enemy{Clown} at least once each.

guide.context: Riot Infected, Jimmy Gibbs Junior, and Fallen Survivors are not part of this four-enemy counter. The required types are spread across multiple launch campaigns.

steps.text: Kill a @enemy{CEDA Worker} in @loc{Dead Center}, a @enemy{Clown} in @loc{Dark Carnival}, a @enemy{Mudman} in @loc{Swamp Fever}, and a @enemy{Worker Infected} in @loc{Hard Rain}.
Check the four-part progress list on the in-game Achievements page and revisit only the missing infected type.

achievements.description: Kill a Jockey within 2 seconds of it jumping on a Survivor.
achievements.summary: Free a mounted survivor by killing the @enemy{Jockey} no later than two seconds after its leap connects.

guide.context: A close shotgun blast or one melee hit can kill the mounted @enemy{Jockey} inside the two-second window. Stand near the intended rider before the leap begins.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{Dead Center}, free a mounted survivor by killing the @enemy{Jockey} no later than two seconds after its leap connects.

achievements.description: Decapitate 200 Infected with a melee weapon.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 200 infected decapitations with melee attacks.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, accumulate 200 infected decapitations with melee attacks.

achievements.description: In a Versus round, leave the saferoom to defibrillate a dead teammate.
achievements.summary: During @mechanic{Versus}, cross the saferoom threshold and then return outside to revive a dead teammate with a @item{defibrillator}.

guide.context: The teammate must be killed by infected or environmental damage; friendly-fire killing the teammate can deny credit. Stage the body and defibrillator just outside the saferoom before the pursuing player enters.

steps.text: In a private @mechanic{Versus} round, place a @item{defibrillator} near the next saferoom and let infected kill one survivor outside its door.
Have the pursuing survivor cross fully into the saferoom, turn around, pick up the @item{defibrillator}, and leave the saferoom again.
Use the @item{defibrillator} on the dead teammate's body while standing outside the saferoom.

achievements.description: Survive all campaigns on Expert.
achievements.summary: On @mechanic{Expert}, reach the rescue ending in each launch campaign: @loc{The Parish}, @loc{Hard Rain}, @loc{Swamp Fever}, @loc{Dark Carnival}, and @loc{Dead Center}.

guide.context: Only the five campaigns present at launch count. Stay active through each escape cutscene; going idle during the cutscene can make the credits record the character as dead and deny credit.

steps.text: Set the lobby difficulty to @mechanic{Expert}, then clear the five launch campaigns; work backward through @loc{The Parish}, @loc{Hard Rain}, @loc{Swamp Fever}, @loc{Dark Carnival}, and @loc{Dead Center}.
Personally board each rescue vehicle, remain active through the escape cutscene, and verify every campaign checkmark on the in-game Achievements page.

achievements.description: Survive a campaign on Expert skill with Realism mode enabled.
achievements.summary: Complete any full campaign with @mechanic{Realism} enabled and the difficulty set to @mechanic{Expert}.

guide.context: This can overlap one campaign required for the five-campaign Expert achievement. Realism removes survivor outlines and limits closet rescues, so a coordinated human team is substantially safer than bots.

steps.text: Create a campaign lobby, select @mechanic{Realism}, set difficulty to @mechanic{Expert}, and start from the first chapter.
Reach and board the rescue vehicle without going idle during the escape cutscene; the achievement registers when the credits begin.

achievements.description: Form a team and beat an enemy team in 4v4 Versus or Scavenge.
achievements.summary: Enter Team @mechanic{Versus} or Team @mechanic{Scavenge} as one of four human players, then defeat four human opponents.

guide.context: Ordinary public Versus does not satisfy the team-match requirement. Because Team lobbies are sparsely populated, organize eight players before queueing.

steps.text: Organize two groups of four human players and choose Team @mechanic{Versus} or Team @mechanic{Scavenge}.
Match the two teams into the same game, keep all eight players connected, and have the pursuing team win the completed match.

achievements.description: Kill 10 swampy Mudmen while they are in the water.
achievements.summary: While fighting in water, eliminate 10 submerged @enemy{Mudmen}.

guide.context: @enemy{Mudmen} are common in @loc{Swamp Fever}; kills count only while their bodies are still standing in swamp water. A pipe bomb or bile jar thrown into the water groups them.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{Swamp Fever}, while fighting in water, eliminate 10 submerged @enemy{Mudmen}.

achievements.description: Collect 10 vials of Boomer vomit from infected CEDA agents you have killed.
achievements.summary: Kill infected @enemy{CEDA agents} and personally pick up 10 of their dropped bile jars.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{Dead Center}, kill infected @enemy{CEDA agents} and personally pick up 10 of their dropped bile jars.

achievements.description: Kill 15 Infected with a single grenade launcher blast.
achievements.summary: Group at least 15 infected tightly enough to eliminate the entire group with one @item{grenade launcher} explosion.

guide.context: A gauntlet horde or a bile jar can pack more than 15 Common Infected into one blast radius. Fire into the center only after the group has tightened.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, group at least 15 infected tightly enough to eliminate the entire group with one @item{grenade launcher} explosion.

achievements.description: Ignite 50 Common Infected with incendiary ammo.
achievements.summary: Load @item{incendiary ammo} and set a cumulative 50 @enemy{Common Infected} alight.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, load @item{incendiary ammo} and set a cumulative 50 @enemy{Common Infected} alight.

achievements.description: Deploy an ammo upgrade and have your team use it.
achievements.summary: Place an explosive- or incendiary-ammo pack, then let teammates take upgraded rounds from the deployed pack.

guide.context: The deployer must place the upgrade pack on the ground, and another survivor must take ammunition from that deployed pile. Merely carrying or dropping the box is insufficient.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, place an explosive- or incendiary-ammo pack, then let teammates take upgraded rounds from the deployed pack.

achievements.description: Revive 10 dead Survivors with the defibrillator.
achievements.summary: Use @item{defibrillators} to return 10 dead survivors to play.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, use @item{defibrillators} to return 10 dead survivors to play.

achievements.description: Revive 10 incapacitated Survivors while under the speed-boosting effects of adrenaline.
achievements.summary: Activate adrenaline before completing each of 10 incapacitated-survivor revives.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, activate adrenaline before completing each of 10 incapacitated-survivor revives.

achievements.description: Kill 100 Common Infected with the chainsaw.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 100 @enemy{Common Infected} kills with the @item{chainsaw}.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, accumulate 100 @enemy{Common Infected} kills with the @item{chainsaw}.

achievements.description: Use a bile bomb on a Tank.
achievements.summary: Hit a living @enemy{Tank} with a thrown @item{bile bomb}.

guide.context: The bile jar must strike the @enemy{Tank} directly and give it the purple outline; splashing a nearby wall, floor, or infected does not count.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, hit a living @enemy{Tank} with a thrown @item{bile bomb}.

achievements.description: Use every melee weapon to kill Common Infected.
achievements.summary: Kill a @enemy{Common Infected} once with each required weapon: katana, nightstick, machete, frying pan, electric guitar, crowbar, cricket bat, and fire axe.

guide.context: The baseball bat, golf club, chainsaw, and combat knife are excluded from this original eight-weapon counter. Progress persists across campaigns and sessions.

steps.text: Across campaign play, pick up the katana, nightstick, machete, frying pan, electric guitar, crowbar, cricket bat, and fire axe.
Personally kill at least one @enemy{Common Infected} with each of the eight weapons, checking the in-game counter after each new type.

achievements.description: Kill a Tank with melee weapons.
achievements.summary: Personally kill a @enemy{Tank} with melee weapons.

guide.context: No firearm, fire, mounted-gun, or bot bullet may damage the @enemy{Tank}. Use human teammates with melee weapons on Easy so every point of damage obeys the restriction.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, personally kill a @enemy{Tank} with melee weapons.

achievements.description: Cross the bridge finale in less than three minutes.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{The Parish} bridge finale in under three minutes, measured from the gate crashing down until the rescue ending triggers.

guide.context: The timer begins when the bridge gate drops, not when the finale button is pressed. The safest route stays left and treats the Tank as an obstacle to bypass rather than a fight.

steps.text: Enter the finale with adrenaline and a melee weapon, activate the bridge, and group at the gate before it falls.
When the gate crashes down, sprint along the left side, use adrenaline before the tanker climb, and run past the Tank.
Have the pursuing player reach the helicopter and trigger the ending before three minutes have elapsed.

achievements.description: Survive the Dead Center campaign.
achievements.summary: Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Dead Center} campaign.

guide.context: Start from the campaign lobby and remain through the rescue and credits so the completion flag is recorded. Easy difficulty is valid unless the achievement explicitly names another setting.

steps.text: Create an Easy Campaign lobby for @loc{Dead Center} and begin at its first chapter.
Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Dead Center} campaign, then stay through the ending cutscene and credits.

achievements.description: Survive the Dark Carnival campaign.
achievements.summary: Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Dark Carnival} campaign.

guide.context: Start from the campaign lobby and remain through the rescue and credits so the completion flag is recorded. Easy difficulty is valid unless the achievement explicitly names another setting.

steps.text: Create an Easy Campaign lobby for @loc{Dark Carnival} and begin at its first chapter.
Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Dark Carnival} campaign, then stay through the ending cutscene and credits.

achievements.description: Survive the Swamp Fever campaign.
achievements.summary: Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Swamp Fever} campaign.

guide.context: Start from the campaign lobby and remain through the rescue and credits so the completion flag is recorded. Easy difficulty is valid unless the achievement explicitly names another setting.

steps.text: Create an Easy Campaign lobby for @loc{Swamp Fever} and begin at its first chapter.
Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Swamp Fever} campaign, then stay through the ending cutscene and credits.

achievements.description: Survive the Hard Rain campaign.
achievements.summary: Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Hard Rain} campaign.

guide.context: Start from the campaign lobby and remain through the rescue and credits so the completion flag is recorded. Easy difficulty is valid unless the achievement explicitly names another setting.

steps.text: Create an Easy Campaign lobby for @loc{Hard Rain} and begin at its first chapter.
Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Hard Rain} campaign, then stay through the ending cutscene and credits.

achievements.description: Survive the Parish campaign.
achievements.summary: Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the Parish campaign.

guide.context: Start from the campaign lobby and remain through the rescue and credits so the completion flag is recorded. Easy difficulty is valid unless the achievement explicitly names another setting.

steps.text: Create an Easy Campaign lobby for @loc{The Parish} and begin at its first chapter.
Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the Parish campaign, then stay through the ending cutscene and credits.

achievements.description: Navigate the impound lot and reach the cemetery safe room without tripping any alarms.
achievements.summary: Cross @loc{The Parish}'s impound lot and close the Cemetery safe room without setting off an alarmed car.

guide.context: A bullet striking an alarmed car or a nearby Boomer explosion can fail the run. Use melee attacks around the marked vehicles and close the Cemetery safe-room door to finish the check.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{The Parish}, cross @loc{The Parish}'s impound lot and close the Cemetery safe room without setting off an alarmed car.

achievements.description: Rescue Gnome Chompski from the Carnival.
achievements.summary: Score 750 points at the @loc{Dark Carnival} shooting gallery, take @item{Gnome Chompski}, and carry the gnome onto the finale helicopter.

guide.context: Only one survivor needs to escape while holding the gnome for the team to receive credit. The @mechanic{Last Gnome on Earth} Mutation can shorten the route by starting at The Concert with the gnome already available.

steps.text: In The Fairgrounds, start the shooting-gallery game and shoot targets until the score reaches 750 and the prize compartment opens.
Pick up @item{Gnome Chompski} and carry or throw the gnome forward through the remaining chapters without leaving it behind.
At The Concert finale, board the rescue helicopter while one survivor is holding @item{Gnome Chompski}.

achievements.description: Navigate the sugar mill and reach the safe room without killing any Witches.
achievements.summary: Cross @loc{Hard Rain}'s Sugar Mill chapter and enter its safe room without any Witch being killed.

guide.context: Startling a Witch does not by itself fail the condition; killing one does. Turn off flashlights and use a solo-friendly Mutation such as Last Man on Earth if bots repeatedly disturb the route.

steps.text: Start the Sugar Mill chapter on Easy, switch off every flashlight, and approach each crying Witch slowly.
Detour around every Witch and do not shoot, burn, or melee any of them, even if one becomes startled.
Enter and close the Sugar Mill safe-room door with no Witch killed during the chapter.

achievements.description: Defend yourself at the crashed airliner without taking damage.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Swamp Fever}'s crashed-airliner crescendo without the pursuing survivor losing any health.

guide.context: This is individual, not team-wide: only the player earning it must avoid damage. Temporary-health items can confuse the health comparison, and even friendly fire can invalidate the attempt.

steps.text: Reach the crashed plane in The Swamp with full permanent health and avoid pills or adrenaline before activating the door.
Open the emergency door, then shelter behind the last accessible row of seats inside the plane while teammates handle the horde.
Take no infected, acid, fire, or friendly-fire damage until the crescendo ends.

achievements.description: As the Jockey, ride a Survivor for more than 12 seconds.
achievements.summary: Control a @enemy{Jockey} and remain mounted on one survivor for longer than 12 seconds.

guide.context: Use two human players: one @enemy{Jockey} and one healthy survivor separated from the bots. A green-health target provides enough time for a ride longer than 12 seconds.

steps.text: In a private @mechanic{Versus} lobby with one human on each team, isolate the healthy survivor, mount that survivor as the @enemy{Jockey}, and prevent a rescue for more than 12 seconds.

achievements.description: As the Jockey, ride the Survivors twice in a single life.
achievements.summary: During one life as a @enemy{Jockey}, successfully mount survivors on two separate attacks.

guide.context: Use two human players and let bots provide the second survivor target. The same @enemy{Jockey} must survive the first rescue and land the second mount before dying.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, mount one survivor as the @enemy{Jockey}, let the human survivor free that target without killing the Jockey, then mount a different survivor during the same Jockey life.

achievements.description: As the Jockey, ride a Survivor and steer them into a Spitter's acid patch.
achievements.summary: Mount a survivor as the @enemy{Jockey}, then steer the captive into a teammate's acid pool.

guide.context: Use three humans: a @enemy{Jockey}, a teammate @enemy{Spitter}, and the survivor target. The acid pool must already be placed where the Jockey can steer the captive through it.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, have the @enemy{Spitter} place acid on open ground, then have the @enemy{Jockey} mount the cooperating survivor and steer that survivor into the active pool.

achievements.description: As the Spitter, hit every Survivor with a single acid patch.
achievements.summary: Cover all four opposing survivors with one acid pool while controlling the @enemy{Spitter}.

guide.context: Use five humans: one @enemy{Spitter} and four opposing survivors. A narrow saferoom or elevator keeps all four targets inside one acid-pool radius.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, cluster all four human survivors in a tight corner, then have the human @enemy{Spitter} place one acid pool beneath the entire group.

achievements.displayName: A SPITTLE HELP FROM MY FRIENDS
achievements.description: As the Spitter, spit on a Survivor being choked by a Smoker.
achievements.summary: Place a @enemy{Spitter} acid pool beneath a survivor after a teammate's @enemy{Smoker} begins choking that survivor.

guide.context: Use three humans: @enemy{Spitter}, teammate @enemy{Smoker}, and survivor. The Spitter should attack only after the Smoker's tongue tightens and choking damage begins.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, have the @enemy{Smoker} secure and choke the survivor, then place the @enemy{Spitter}'s acid pool directly beneath the restrained survivor.

achievements.description: As the Charger, bowl through the entire enemy team in a single charge.
achievements.summary: Drive one @enemy{Charger} rush through all four opposing survivors.

guide.context: Use five humans: one @enemy{Charger} and four opposing survivors. Line all four survivors shoulder-to-shoulder in a narrow corridor so one charge contacts the complete team.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, line up four human survivors in a corridor and charge through all four with the human @enemy{Charger} during one uninterrupted rush.

achievements.description: As the Charger, grab a Survivor and smash them into the ground for a solid 15 seconds.
achievements.summary: Keep one survivor pinned under a @enemy{Charger's} ground pummel for 15 uninterrupted seconds.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams. Give the survivor full health, isolate the target from rescuers, and avoid walls or ledges that could end the pummel early.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, grab the healthy human survivor as the @enemy{Charger} and keep the survivor pinned under ground slams for 15 uninterrupted seconds.

achievements.description: As the Charger, grab a Survivor and carry them over 80 feet.
achievements.summary: Use one @enemy{Charger} rush to carry a grabbed survivor farther than 80 feet.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams and a straight route longer than 80 feet. Long hotel corridors or downhill roads reduce the risk of the charge hitting an obstacle.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, place the human survivor at one end of a long clear corridor, then charge from the opposite end and carry the survivor more than 80 feet.

achievements.description: In a Survival round, get a medal only using melee weapons.
achievements.summary: Earn a new @mechanic{Survival} medal while every survivor uses no firearms; on PC, the whole team must keep the melee-only restriction.

guide.context: Since The Last Stand update, a bot picking up and firing a primary weapon can invalidate the attempt. Use human teammates, choose a map where the pursuing group has not earned every medal tier, and target a fresh four-minute bronze.

steps.text: Choose an official @mechanic{Survival} map with an unearned medal tier and enter with human teammates.
Have every survivor equip melee and avoid firing pistols or primary weapons, including while incapacitated.
Survive at least four minutes to earn a new medal without anyone breaking the firearms restriction.

achievements.description: Win a game of Scavenge.
achievements.summary: Win a game of @mechanic{Scavenge}.

guide.context: Two humans, one on each team, are sufficient for a private match with bots filling the teams. The pursuing player's team must lead when the configured game ends.

steps.text: Create a private single-round @mechanic{Scavenge} match with one human on each team, score at least one gas can on the pursuing survivor side, prevent the opponent from matching that score, and finish the game.

achievements.description: Collect 100 gas cans in Scavenge.
achievements.summary: Personally pour 100 gas cans into the scoring target across @mechanic{Scavenge} matches.

guide.context: Team deliveries do not replace personal credit for this cumulative counter. Short, cooperative rounds on compact maps reduce the travel between each pickup and pour.

steps.text: Create a private @mechanic{Scavenge} lobby on a compact map and play the survivor side.
Carry and personally pour each available gas can into the generator or vehicle rather than handing the pour to a teammate.
Repeat short rounds until the in-game personal counter reaches 100 poured cans.

achievements.description: Collect 15 gas cans in a single Scavenge round.
achievements.summary: During one @mechanic{Scavenge} round, have the survivor team deliver 15 gas cans.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams and choose a map configured with at least 15 cans. Team deliveries count for the survivor team, so cooperating survivors may split carries and pours.

steps.text: In a private @mechanic{Scavenge} round with one human on each team, have the pursuing survivor team pour 15 gas cans before the round timer expires.

achievements.description: Stop the enemy team from collecting any gas cans during a Scavenge round.
achievements.summary: Win a @mechanic{Scavenge} round after preventing the opposing survivor team from scoring even one gas can.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams. The pursuing infected side must end the opponent's survivor round before that team pours any gas can into the scoring target.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Scavenge}, score on the pursuing team's survivor turn, then use the infected turn to prevent the opposing survivors from pouring even one gas can until their timer expires.

achievements.description: Prove you are stronger than Moustachio.
achievements.summary: At @loc{Dark Carnival}'s fairground strength tester, use adrenaline and strike the red pad with a melee weapon to ring the bell.

guide.context: The adrenaline speed boost is required to generate enough force; ordinary melee swings do not reach the target score.

steps.text: In The Fairgrounds chapter, find the Moustachio strength tester and bring an adrenaline shot plus any melee weapon.
Use the adrenaline, stand at the red striking pad, and immediately hit the pad with the melee weapon until the bell rings.

achievements.description: Make a Survivor drop a gas can during overtime.
achievements.summary: During @mechanic{Scavenge} overtime, attack the survivor carrying the final active gas can and force that can to fall.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams. Overtime begins when the clock reaches zero while a survivor is still carrying a gas can; the infected hit must make that carrier release it.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Scavenge}, let the human survivor hold a gas can as the timer reaches zero, then attack that gas-can carrier as infected and force the can to fall during overtime.

achievements.description: Cause 25 gas can drops as a Special Infected.
achievements.summary: As infected, build a cumulative total of 25 forced gas-can drops.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams. Direct pins or impacts from @enemy{Jockeys}, @enemy{Hunters}, @enemy{Smokers}, or @enemy{Chargers} reliably force a carried can to drop; Spitter acid may not credit the counter.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Scavenge}, have the human survivor repeatedly pick up a can and use direct Special Infected attacks to force 25 cumulative drops.

achievements.description: Prove you are faster than Moustachio.
achievements.summary: At @loc{Dark Carnival}'s Whack-A-Nut machine in The Barns, score 42 total target hits.

guide.context: Starting another game before the current countdown ends preserves the machine score, so the 42 points need not come from one timed attempt. Hitting at least one target grants team members credit when the target score is reached.

steps.text: In @loc{Dark Carnival}'s The Barns chapter, find the Moustachio Whack-A-Nut cabinet and press its start button.
Shoot each lit target; if the timer nears zero, start another game before the countdown finishes so the score carries forward.
Continue until the cabinet reaches 42 points and triggers the success event.

achievements.description: Survive The Passing Campaign.
achievements.summary: Reach the rescue vehicle and survive @loc{The Passing} Campaign.

guide.context: Start from the campaign lobby and remain through the rescue and credits so the completion flag is recorded. Easy difficulty is valid unless the achievement explicitly names another setting.

steps.text: Create an Easy Campaign lobby for @loc{The Passing} and begin at its first chapter.
Reach the rescue vehicle and survive @loc{The Passing} Campaign, then stay through the ending cutscene and credits.

achievements.description: As the Charger, grab a Survivor and crash them through 8 chairs at the wedding.
achievements.summary: At @loc{The Passing} wedding, carry a grabbed survivor through eight chairs during one @enemy{Charger} rush.

guide.context: Use two humans at @loc{The Passing}'s waterfront wedding pavilion. Keep the eight chairs intact and align the survivor so one @enemy{Charger} carry crosses the full row.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus} on @loc{The Passing}, position the human survivor beyond the wedding chairs, then charge, grab, and carry that survivor through eight chairs in one rush.

achievements.description: Using the M60, kill 25 infected without letting go of the trigger.
achievements.summary: Hold the @item{M60} trigger continuously while scoring at least 25 infected kills.

guide.context: @loc{The Passing} Survival maps provide a reliable @item{M60}. A bile jar can hold a dense horde in front of the muzzle while the trigger remains depressed.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{The Passing}, hold the @item{M60} trigger continuously while scoring at least 25 infected kills.

achievements.description: Collect 10 items dropped by a Fallen Survivor.
achievements.summary: Loot 10 cumulative item drops from slain @enemy{Fallen Survivors}.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{The Passing}, loot 10 cumulative item drops from slain @enemy{Fallen Survivors}.

achievements.description: Play 6 Mutations.
achievements.summary: In six different Valve-recognized @mechanic{Mutations}, let the survivor die and wait for the round to restart so each mode records credit.

guide.context: A full round is unnecessary: the game records a Mutation after the player's survivor dies and the round restarts. Some accounts can stop updating after the fifth entry, so verify the counter after every mode.

steps.text: From the main menu, select six different official @mechanic{Mutations}, using @loc{Dead Center}'s first chapter for quick loading.
In each Mutation, move from the hotel balcony and die from the fall, wait for the round to restart, then return to the menu.
Check that the in-game counter advanced before launching the next Mutation; retry a different official Mutation if one did not register.

achievements.description: Knock off the heads of 18 infected with the golf club.
achievements.summary: Use the @item{golf club} to decapitate 18 infected.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{The Passing}, use the @item{golf club} to decapitate 18 infected.

achievements.displayName: KILLING THEM SWIFTLY TO THIS SONG
achievements.description: Play the new Midnight Riders song on a jukebox.
achievements.summary: Use a jukebox in @loc{The Passing} until it selects the Midnight Riders track “Save Me Some Sugar,” subtitled “This Won't Take Long.”

guide.context: Each button press advances to another song, and all survivors receive credit when the required track begins. A jukebox is available in the second chapter's pool hall.

steps.text: In The Passing's second chapter, enter the pool hall that appears ahead of the roadworks and find its jukebox.
Press the jukebox button repeatedly, waiting for each selection to begin, until “Save Me Some Sugar,” subtitled “This Won't Take Long,” starts playing.

achievements.description: Kill a Tank only with damage from the original Survivors.
achievements.summary: During @loc{The Passing} finale, let only the original Left 4 Dead survivors damage and kill a @enemy{Tank}.

guide.context: The current four survivors must withhold all damage, including stray bullets and fire. The original survivors fire from the elevated position beside the generator area.

steps.text: Activate The Passing finale and wait near the original survivors' firing position until a @enemy{Tank} spawns.
Have every current survivor stop attacking and kite the @enemy{Tank} within sight of the original survivors.
Let the original survivors deal all damage until the @enemy{Tank} dies.

achievements.description: Open 5 foot lockers.
achievements.summary: Personally open 5 foot lockers.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{The Passing}, personally open 5 foot lockers.

achievements.description: Play 5 full games of Scavenge on The Port.
achievements.summary: Finish five complete @mechanic{Scavenge} matches on @loc{The Port}; single-round matches count.

guide.context: Use two humans, one on each team, and select @loc{The Port}. A single-round lobby shortens each game, but both survivor turns must finish for the game to count.

steps.text: Complete five private single-round @mechanic{Scavenge} games on @loc{The Port} with one human on each team, remaining through both sides and each final score screen.

achievements.description: Complete "The Sacrifice".
achievements.summary: Finish "@loc{The Sacrifice}".

guide.context: Start from the campaign lobby and remain through the rescue and credits so the completion flag is recorded. Easy difficulty is valid unless the achievement explicitly names another setting.

steps.text: Create an Easy Campaign lobby for @loc{The Sacrifice} and begin at its first chapter.
Finish "@loc{The Sacrifice}", then stay through the ending cutscene and credits.

achievements.description: Have Bill sacrifice himself for the team.
achievements.summary: Play as @npc{Bill} in @loc{The Sacrifice} finale and restart the failed generator yourself.

guide.context: The generator restart is the finale's sacrifice action. The team may still receive campaign-completion credit even though Bill dies.

steps.text: Select @npc{Bill}, complete The Sacrifice, and start the finale generators.
After the bridge rises and a generator fails, leave the bridge as @npc{Bill}, reach the stopped generator, and hold its restart control until the sacrifice sequence triggers.

achievements.description: Kill a Special Infected with an exploding barrel.
achievements.summary: Detonate an explosive barrel and make that blast deliver the killing damage to a @enemy{Special Infected}.

guide.context: Explosive barrels appear in @loc{The Sacrifice}. Weaken a Special Infected first, lure it beside a barrel, and make the barrel explosion deliver the final damage.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{The Sacrifice}, detonate an explosive barrel and make that blast deliver the killing damage to a @enemy{Special Infected}.

achievements.description: Have all 3 generators running at once in "The Sacrifice" finale.
achievements.summary: In @loc{The Sacrifice} finale, have three human survivors start the three generators simultaneously so all three are running together.

guide.context: Bots follow human players and cannot reliably coordinate the three starts, so use at least three people. The requirement concerns starting all generators at once, not merely having completed them eventually.

steps.text: Bring at least three human players to The Sacrifice finale and assign one player to each generator.
Have all three players begin holding their generator controls on the same countdown.
Keep holding until all three engines are audibly running at the same time.

achievements.description: As a Special Infected, incap someone who is trying to sacrifice themselves.
achievements.summary: While playing infected in @loc{The Sacrifice} finale, incapacitate the survivor who is restarting the failed generator.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams in @loc{The Sacrifice} finale. The survivor must be actively holding the failed generator's restart control when the infected attack causes incapacitation.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus} on @loc{The Sacrifice}, let the human survivor begin restarting the failed finale generator, then incapacitate that survivor with the human infected player before the restart completes.

achievements.description: Survive the Cold Stream campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Cold Stream} campaign on any difficulty.

guide.context: Start from the campaign lobby and remain through the rescue and credits so the completion flag is recorded. Easy difficulty is valid unless the achievement explicitly names another setting.

steps.text: Create an Easy Campaign lobby for @loc{Cold Stream} and begin at its first chapter.
Reach the rescue vehicle and survive the @loc{Cold Stream} campaign on any difficulty, then stay through the ending cutscene and credits.

achievements.description: Play a Versus game on Dead Air from start to finish.
achievements.summary: Stay in one @mechanic{Versus} match on @loc{Dead Air} from the opening chapter until the finale match ends.

guide.context: Joining only the finale does not count. Start from the lobby, remain connected through map transitions, and complete both teams' finale turns.

steps.text: Create or join a @loc{Dead Air} @mechanic{Versus} lobby set to begin at the first chapter.
Remain in the same match through every chapter and both sides of the finale until the final score screen appears.

achievements.description: Collect three gifts dropped by Special Infected in Versus Mode.
achievements.summary: During December, play @mechanic{Versus} and collect three gift boxes dropped by killed @enemy{Special Infected}.

guide.context: The Last Stand update restored December activation in any year despite the achievement's 2011 title. Outside December, ordinary official play does not produce the required gifts.

steps.text: During December, join a @mechanic{Versus} match on an official or achievement-enabled server.
While playing Survivor, kill @enemy{Special Infected} and watch their bodies for holiday gift boxes.
Personally pick up three dropped gifts; the counter persists across matches during the active period.

achievements.description: Plays games with free weekend players and helps them survive a campaign.
achievements.summary: During an active Left 4 Dead 2 free weekend, help a free-weekend player reach a campaign rescue vehicle while using a paid account.

guide.context: The qualifying license state activates only during a Valve free-weekend promotion. A player who permanently received the game through the holiday giveaway does not qualify for this achievement.

steps.text: Wait for Valve to activate a Left 4 Dead 2 free weekend, then use an account that owns a paid license.
Start an Easy or Normal campaign lobby with a player currently using the free-weekend license.
Keep that free-weekend player alive through the rescue and wait for the ending credits to begin.

achievements.description: Spread cheer by helping a free holiday player survive a campaign.
achievements.summary: Help a player who permanently claimed Left 4 Dead 2 during Valve's December 2013 giveaway survive a campaign rescue.

guide.context: This is a viral license check, not a current holiday event. A qualifying 2013 giveaway owner can still provide the unlock, but custom campaigns and modded servers do not count.

steps.text: Find a player whose account permanently received Left 4 Dead 2 during Valve's December 2013 giveaway.
Launch an official campaign together from the lobby and ensure the qualifying player reaches the rescue vehicle.
Remain connected through the escape cutscene; the achievement registers when the credits begin.

achievements.description: Earn a bronze medal on any official Survival map.
achievements.summary: Survive for at least four minutes on one @mechanic{Survival} map to earn a bronze medal.

guide.context: The timer begins when the event is started. Bronze is the first medal threshold and can be earned on any official Survival arena.

steps.text: Choose an official @mechanic{Survival} map, start the event, and keep at least one survivor alive until the timer reaches four minutes.

achievements.description: Earn a silver medal on any official survival map.
achievements.summary: Survive for at least seven minutes on one @mechanic{Survival} map to earn a silver medal.

guide.context: Silver automatically includes the bronze threshold on the same run, so a seven-minute hold can unlock both early medal achievements.

steps.text: Choose an official @mechanic{Survival} map, start the event, and keep at least one survivor alive until the timer reaches seven minutes.

achievements.displayName: THIS IS WHERE THE FUN BEGINS
achievements.description: Earn a gold medal on any official survival map.
achievements.summary: Survive for at least ten minutes on one @mechanic{Survival} map to earn a gold medal.

guide.context: A ten-minute result also clears the bronze and silver thresholds for that arena. Use the same coordinated setup later needed for all-map gold medals.

steps.text: Choose an official @mechanic{Survival} map, start the event, and keep at least one survivor alive until the timer reaches ten minutes.

achievements.description: Survive The Last Stand campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Reach the rescue ending of @loc{The Last Stand} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Start from the campaign lobby and remain through the rescue and credits so the completion flag is recorded. Easy difficulty is valid unless the achievement explicitly names another setting.

steps.text: Create an Easy Campaign lobby for @loc{The Last Stand} and begin at its first chapter.
Reach the rescue ending of @loc{The Last Stand} on any difficulty, then stay through the ending cutscene and credits.

achievements.description: Survive The Last Stand campaign on Expert Realism.
achievements.summary: Reach @loc{The Last Stand}'s rescue ending with @mechanic{Realism} enabled on @mechanic{Expert}.

guide.context: The campaign has only two chapters, but Expert Realism removes survivor outlines and makes recovery from deaths difficult. Human teammates can coordinate the finale's fuel and lighthouse defense more reliably than bots.

steps.text: Create a @loc{The Last Stand} campaign lobby, select @mechanic{Realism}, set difficulty to @mechanic{Expert}, and begin the first chapter.
Complete the junkyard and lighthouse objectives, then have the pursuing player board the rescue boat and remain active through the credits.

achievements.description: Find the golden crowbars hidden in the Left 4 Dead 1 survival maps.
achievements.summary: Across the Left 4 Dead 1 @mechanic{Survival} arenas, locate and touch the full set of 22 concealed @item{golden crowbars}.

guide.context: The pickups are available before starting each Survival event, so collect one and leave without playing the round. The Achievements page tracks all 22 arena names.

steps.text: @loc{No Mercy}: take the crowbars from the Generator Room spawn pipes, Gas Station sloped roof by the crashed truck, Hospital storage-room top shelf, and Rooftop platform corner near the helipad.
@loc{Crash Course}: check behind the Bridge booth's concrete barrier and on a bus fender at the rear of Truck Depot.
@loc{Death Toll}: search above the Drains spawn sewer pipe, the Church ledge above the piano, the Street theater booth, and the Boathouse tree beside the farther sloped rock.
@loc{Dead Air}: collect from the Crane's burning barrel, behind the Construction Site pillar beside scaffolding, the Terminal men's-room wall urinal, and the end of the farthest Runway gangway.
@loc{Blood Harvest}: drop onto the Warehouse crate beneath the walkway, look behind the Bridge train car nearest the derailment, and check beside chopped logs at the Farmhouse barn's rear wall.
@loc{The Sacrifice}: grab the Train Car fire escape from the boat jump, the Barge roof edge above the lorry, and the Port sloped roof near the far generator.
@loc{The Last Stand}: check behind the Junkyard container beside the magnet target and on the Lighthouse outer windowsill reached from the highest stair railing.

achievements.description: Revive an incapacitated teammate while a Tank is nearby.
achievements.summary: Complete an incapacitated-teammate revive while an active @enemy{Tank} remains close to the group.

guide.context: Have one survivor distract the @enemy{Tank} away from the incapacitated teammate; the Tank can interrupt the revive by pounding the downed survivor.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, complete an incapacitated-teammate revive while an active @enemy{Tank} remains close to the group.

achievements.description: As the Spitter, spit on a Survivor who is pinned by a Charger.
achievements.summary: As a @enemy{Spitter}, land acid beneath a survivor currently pinned by a teammate's @enemy{Charger}.

guide.context: Use three humans: @enemy{Spitter}, teammate @enemy{Charger}, and survivor. Wait until the Charger has secured the pin before placing acid under the captive.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, have the @enemy{Charger} pin the human survivor, then have the teammate @enemy{Spitter} place acid beneath the pinned target.

achievements.description: As the Spitter, spit on a Survivor who is pinned by a Hunter.
achievements.summary: As a @enemy{Spitter}, land acid beneath a survivor currently pinned by a teammate's @enemy{Hunter}.

guide.context: Use three humans: @enemy{Spitter}, teammate @enemy{Hunter}, and survivor. The Hunter must still be pinning the target when the acid begins dealing damage.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, have the @enemy{Hunter} pounce and pin the human survivor, then have the teammate @enemy{Spitter} place acid beneath the pinned target.

achievements.description: Destroy 20 gascans as the Spitter.
achievements.summary: As a @enemy{Spitter}, use acid pools to destroy 20 gas cans across @mechanic{Scavenge} rounds.

guide.context: @loc{Dead Center}'s Atrium places many cans around a compact central target. Destroyed cans accumulate across rounds, but merely making a survivor drop a can does not count as destruction.

steps.text: Create a private @loc{Dead Center} Atrium @mechanic{Scavenge} lobby and wait to spawn as a @enemy{Spitter}.
Have the survivors group unused gas cans together away from the scoring target.
Spit directly onto the pile and let the acid destroy the cans; repeat rounds until 20 destroyed cans register.

achievements.description: Instantly kill a Survivor as the Charger.
achievements.summary: Use a @enemy{Charger} carry to send a survivor over a lethal edge for an immediate death.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams and a lethal drop such as @loc{Dead Center}'s hotel elevator shaft. The @enemy{Charger} carry itself must send the target over the edge.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, stand the human survivor beside a lethal ledge, then charge from the aligned approach and carry the survivor over the edge for an instant death.

achievements.description: As the Boomer, vomit on a Survivor without having direct line of sight with them.
achievements.summary: Arc a @enemy{Boomer's} vomit around cover and hit a survivor who is not directly visible.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams with a wall or corner between them. The @enemy{Boomer's} vomit travels as an arc, so aim above the cover without exposing the survivor to direct sight.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, hide the human survivor behind a corner, stand out of direct sight as the @enemy{Boomer}, and arc vomit over or around the cover until it hits.

achievements.description: Rescue three Survivors from a single rescue closet.
achievements.summary: Open one rescue closet while three dead teammates are waiting inside, returning all three survivors together.

guide.context: The motel section of @loc{Dark Carnival} has an early rescue closet. Three teammates must be fully dead and waiting inside the same closet before the fourth survivor opens it.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, open one rescue closet while three dead teammates are waiting inside, returning all three survivors together.

achievements.description: With a sharp melee weapon, cut a Smoker's tongue before he ensnares you.
achievements.summary: Swing a sharp melee weapon through the incoming tongue and sever it before the @enemy{Smoker} secures the grab.

guide.context: The melee swing must intersect the tongue while it is travelling toward the pursuing survivor, before the tongue tightens and begins dragging.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, swing a sharp melee weapon through the incoming tongue and sever it before the @enemy{Smoker} secures the grab.

achievements.description: Kill a pouncing Hunter with a shotgun.
achievements.summary: Shoot and kill a @enemy{Hunter} with a shotgun while the infected player is airborne in a pounce.

guide.context: Pre-aim a shotgun at the @enemy{Hunter} and fire while its pounce is airborne. Killing it before takeoff or after it lands does not satisfy the timing.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, shoot and kill a @enemy{Hunter} with a shotgun while the infected player is airborne in a pounce.

achievements.description: Destroy a Tank's rock in mid-air.
achievements.summary: Shoot a thrown @enemy{Tank} rock out of the air before it hits anything.

guide.context: Automatic weapons make the airborne rock easier to hit. Track the @enemy{Tank}'s wind-up, then fire at the rock after release and before impact.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, shoot a thrown @enemy{Tank} rock out of the air before it hits anything.

achievements.description: Kill the Witch bride with a single shotgun blast on expert difficulty.
achievements.summary: On @mechanic{Expert}, kill @loc{The Passing}'s bride Witch with one close-range shotgun shot.

guide.context: The bride appears in the first chapter's wedding area. Only one shotgun blast may damage her, so teammates must hold fire and the shooter must aim at the head from point-blank range.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Passing}'s first chapter on @mechanic{Expert}, take a pump or chrome shotgun, and reach the wedding area.
Have teammates stop attacking, approach the seated bride Witch from behind, and place the shotgun crosshair on her head at point-blank range.
Fire once as the bride begins to rise; any follow-up shot invalidates the one-blast requirement.

achievements.description: As the Hunter, land a 25 damage pounce.
achievements.summary: Launch a @enemy{Hunter} pounce from enough distance or height for the impact indicator to show 25 damage.

guide.context: Use two humans on opposing teams. Hunter impact damage scales with travel distance and height, so choose a high roof with a clear landing zone and use the on-screen damage number as confirmation.

steps.text: In private @mechanic{Versus}, place the human survivor below a high ledge, leap from the ledge as the @enemy{Hunter}, and land the pounce far enough away for the impact indicator to show 25 damage.

achievements.description: Kill 20 Jockeys with the shovel or pitchfork.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 20 @enemy{Jockey} kills using either the @item{shovel} or the @item{pitchfork}.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{The Last Stand}, accumulate 20 @enemy{Jockey} kills using either the @item{shovel} or the @item{pitchfork}.

achievements.description: Survive for 10 minutes on any official map in Versus Survival.
achievements.summary: In @mechanic{Versus Survival}, keep the survivor team alive until the round timer reaches 10 minutes.

guide.context: Use at least two humans, one on each team, in @mechanic{Versus Survival}; standard Survival does not count. The achievement is awarded to survivors who are still active when the timer reaches 10 minutes.

steps.text: Create a private @mechanic{Versus Survival} lobby with one human on each team, start the arena event, and keep the pursuing survivor side alive until the timer reaches 10 minutes.

achievements.description: Kill 53,599 infected. You made sure the dead won't rise anymore!
achievements.summary: Raise the lifetime infected-kill counter to 53,599.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative across eligible matches. Check the in-game Achievements page between sessions and make the final credited action yourself when the wording requires personal credit.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, raise the lifetime infected-kill counter to 53,599.

achievements.description: Escape Liberty Mall's Atrium before the first Tank appears
achievements.summary: Fill the stock car and escape @loc{Dead Center}'s Atrium finale before the first @enemy{Tank} spawns.

guide.context: The first Tank is tied to elapsed finale time and can-collection progress, so four humans should stage nearby cans before pouring and avoid unnecessary combat.

steps.text: Reach the Atrium finale with four human survivors and immediately split into pairs to retrieve gas cans.
Throw cans toward the stock car, then pour continuously while teammates cover the filler.
Finish the final pour and trigger the escape before the first @enemy{Tank} appears.

achievements.description: Discover the hidden room in the Last Stand campaign
achievements.summary: In the first chapter of @loc{The Last Stand}, break open the metal door on the right side of the first house and enter the hidden room.

guide.context: The concealed door is destructible and is easiest to identify with a melee weapon ready. The achievement triggers on entering the opened room.

steps.text: Start The Last Stand's first chapter and reach the first house.
Inspect the right side for a metal door, strike the door with a melee weapon until it breaks, and walk into the hidden room.

achievements.description: Earn a bronze medal on every official survival map
achievements.summary: On each official @mechanic{Survival} arena, hold out for the four minutes needed to record bronze or better.

guide.context: Higher medals satisfy lower thresholds on the same map. Track the arena list in the Achievements menu so no campaign location is skipped.

steps.text: Work through every official @mechanic{Survival} arena and keep at least one survivor alive for four minutes on each uncredited map.

achievements.description: Earn a silver medal on every official survival map.
achievements.summary: On each official @mechanic{Survival} arena, hold out for the seven minutes needed to record silver or better.

guide.context: Gold results also satisfy silver for that arena. Reuse a consistent four-player team and verify every map's medal in the Achievements menu.

steps.text: Work through every official @mechanic{Survival} arena and keep at least one survivor alive for seven minutes on each map lacking silver.

achievements.description: Earn a gold medal on every official survival map.
achievements.summary: On each official @mechanic{Survival} arena, survive for 10 minutes and record its gold medal.

guide.context: This is the longest skill-based cleanup in the list. A gold run also supplies that arena's bronze and silver credit, so prioritize gold from the beginning.

steps.text: Work through every official @mechanic{Survival} arena with a coordinated team and keep at least one survivor alive for ten minutes on each map.

achievements.description: Survive for 30 minutes on any official survival map.
achievements.summary: Keep at least one survivor alive for 30 minutes in a single @mechanic{Survival} round.

guide.context: Versus Survival does not count. Choose a defensible official arena and keep rotating ammunition, health, and Tank focus long after the ten-minute gold threshold.

steps.text: Start a standard @mechanic{Survival} round on a practiced arena and keep at least one survivor alive continuously until the timer reaches 30 minutes.

achievements.description: Kill a Witch using only a sharp melee weapon, without anyone getting incapacitated or killed.
achievements.summary: Without any teammate dying or becoming incapacitated, deal all damage to one Witch using sharp melee attacks.

guide.context: Every point of damage must come from a sharp melee weapon, and no survivor may be incapacitated or killed. On Easy, circle behind the Witch and have the whole team strike together.

steps.text: In any Easy Campaign, without any teammate dying or becoming incapacitated, deal all damage to one Witch using sharp melee attacks.

achievements.description: On the concert finale, survive until the helicopter arrives without leaving the stage
achievements.summary: During @loc{Dark Carnival}'s concert finale, remain on the stage from activation until the rescue helicopter arrives.

guide.context: The stage boundary is the raised performance platform in @loc{Dark Carnival}'s finale. Supplies can be moved onto it before activation, but stepping down after the concert begins fails the condition.

steps.text: In an Easy Campaign on @loc{Dark Carnival}, during @loc{Dark Carnival}'s concert finale, remain on the stage from activation until the rescue helicopter arrives.

achievements.description: Complete The Last Stand campaign in 13 minutes or less, without any Survivors dying.
achievements.summary: Keep every survivor alive while clearing both @loc{The Last Stand} chapters within a total of 13 minutes.

guide.context: Incapacitations are recoverable, but a full death fails the condition. The timer covers the whole two-chapter campaign, so use four humans and route objectives before starting.

steps.text: Create a four-player Easy lobby for @loc{The Last Stand} and assign objective roles before loading.
Move continuously through both chapters, use throwables to clear forced hordes, and revive incapacitated teammates before anyone dies.
Trigger the finale escape with the campaign timer at or below 13 minutes and all four survivors alive.

achievements.description: If you are reading this achievement, Gabe Newell has successfully launched Gnome Chompski into space.
achievements.summary: Load any playable map once; Valve's completed Gnome Chompski space event awards this achievement automatically.

guide.context: The global event completed in November 2020. Any account that loads a map after that event receives the achievement without carrying or finding a gnome.

steps.text: Launch any campaign, versus, scavenge, or survival map and wait for the playable round to finish loading.
